channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandin Podziemski | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandin Podziemski from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski pregame:

“He's not at his best right now. He's pressing a little bit. Brandin always wants to be great. Sometimes he just needs to relax and be good and that's when his play becomes great.”

Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski, Oct 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Brandin Podziemski
item.description:
“I really got to give credit to all of our scouts: Mike and Kirk, all of those guys, and Ken. We nailed it in this draft. I mean, we did really well. I think Brandin Podziemski in particular, honestly, is a All-Rookie team [player]. Top five guy in the league.”

Joe Lacob on Brandin Podziemski, Feb 15, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski:

“He's gonna be on the floor late game for us the way he recognizes stuff.”

Steve Kerr on Brandin Podziemski, Dec 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaltonJ_Johnson.
